title: German Oat Pudding
description: A hearty and comforting oat pudding dessert, inspired by German cuisine.
instructions: In a medium saucepan, bring the milk to a simmer over medium heat.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the oats, sugar, eggs, and vanilla extract.
Gradually pour the hot milk into the oat mixture, whisking constantly.
Return the mixture to the saucepan and cook over low heat, stirring constantly, for 5-7 minutes.
Remove from heat and let cool slightly.
Transfer the pudding to individual serving dishes and refrigerate for at least 2 hours.
Serve chilled, garnished with a sprinkle of cinnamon if desired.
